entries.note: The domestic network's first row, at OFICINA CENTRAL: the shipment's data is recorded.
The origin agency receiving the shipment's data, hours after it was recorded; no movement of its own.
At the destination hub overnight, which the row names (PT.PLT.…).
At the agency that delivers, before its round.
The round's delivery record. The reply follows it with the signatory's DNI and name, which the adapter leaves out.
The proof of delivery entered at the destination agency after the delivery: a note on the record that moves nothing.
The agency closing the shipment as delivered, after its proof of delivery is entered.
The first row of a parcel sent abroad under a partner's S10 number, at Lisbon.
Customs in the destination country, Brazil for the sample.

entries.wording: Back to sender: transfer cancelled - addressee unreachable
entries.note: The destination post sending the parcel back after customs held it: on its way back, not yet with the sender. Iberomail's reply to the sample's complaint says it was still waiting for the parcel.
